name: Listening_7
short_caption: The robot tilts and turns its head slightly while keeping its arms relaxed at its sides, giving an attentive and listening appearance.
movement_description: The robot starts in a relaxed neutral posture with its arms hanging naturally at its sides. It slowly tilts its head to the right and rotates it slightly, simulating an active listening posture. After a brief pause in this listening stance, the robot gently returns its head to the center, ending in the original neutral posture.
